claim: A vendor backtest on 1,972 SPY days (2018-2026) found end-of-day GEX added no predictive power for next-day realised volatility after controlling for VIX and ATM IV, and dealer delta exposure (DEX) did not predict next-day direction.

evidence.quote: For GEX, the top-minus-bottom residualized realized-vol difference tells the same story: -10.63 vol points raw, -3.15 after VIX, and -0.99 after VIX + ATM IV (p = 0.25).
Top-minus-bottom return difference is 0.00%, t = 0.04, p = 0.97. Raw Spearman ρ is -0.03 with p = 0.19. DEX does not predict next-day SPY direction in this EOD test.

claim: Across 193 SPY 0DTE sessions (Jul 2022-Apr 2026), the 10:00 ET straddle-implied move contained the close-to-close move in 71.0% of sessions, and realised moves were about 13% below implied.

evidence.quote: The 10:00 ET implied move contained the close 71.0% of the time (68.3% if fairly priced), realized moves ran about 13% below what the straddle implied, and the worst single miss was a +8.72% day against a 3.51% implied move.

claim: Baltussen, Da, Lammers & Martens (JFE 2021): intraday momentum in S&P futures is concentrated on days when dealers' net gamma is negative, and is not significant on positive-gamma days.

evidence.quote: Table 7 shows that indeed intraday momentum is much more pronounced on negative NGE days. On days with positive NGE, however, there is no significant intraday momentum.
evidence.source_title: Hedging Demand and Market Intraday Momentum (paper text via Alpha Architect page)

claim: Rosa (Journal of Futures Markets 2022) finds that intraday momentum predictability (overnight return predicting the last half-hour) disappears in the out-of-sample period.

evidence.quote: The predictability disappears in the out‐of‐sample period.

claim: Cboe (2023) found SPX 0DTE market-maker net gamma is small relative to S&P futures volume and found no increase in the frequency of SPX intraday 2-sigma gap moves after 0DTE growth.

evidence.quote: we find no increase in frequency of such gap moves over the past year since the proliferation of 0DTE trading
